title: Model Info
text: Display model properties and text in model, {Horizontal text alignment} sets Horizontal text alignment on block mask; {Enter text and tokens to display on Model Info block} sets the content and format of the text to display Model and {Show block frame} sets the frame for block mask. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Enter text and tokens to display on Model Info block
params.values: Content and format of the text to display Model Info (default) | text

params.name: Horizontal text alignment
params.values: Horizontal text alignment on block mask Center (default) | Left | Right

params.name: Show block frame
params.values: Frame for block mask on (default) | off
